t: A one-euro solder-it-yourself retro computer kit with VGA and a keyboard port.
steps: Order the RVPC kit from the Olimex store.
Get a soldering iron, solder, a 5 V barrel jack supply, a PS/2 keyboard, and a VGA monitor.
Download the RVPC user manual from the Olimex GitHub page.
Solder the parts onto the board in the order the manual shows.
Plug in the keyboard, monitor, and power.
Use the preloaded monitor program to read a few memory addresses.
Get a one-wire SWIO programmer to load new demos later.
Install PlatformIO in VS Code and build the Tetris demo.
